This '''secret facility''' was a hidden [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] military installation located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was destroyed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Behpour]].
